ir.name: hinge_advantage_weighted_pairwise_loss_v1
ir.intuition: Shift from margin-based logits and sigmoid link to a hinge loss paradigm which enforces a margin on the difference of log probabilities directly, weighted by advantage_gap and sample weight. This uses a max(0, margin - scaled_diff) hinge formulation without probabilistic link functions, promoting robustness by penalizing insufficient margin between preferred and less preferred samples. Aggregation is weighted mean, with normalization based on advantage vector norms to control scale. This structural change departs from pairwise margin sigmoid frameworks to a margin hinge loss aligned with ranking objectives.
ir.pseudocode:
epsilon = 1e-6
norm = max(mean(norm(advantage_gap)), epsilon)
diff = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) / norm
margin_scalar = clamp(mean(advantage_gap), 0, 1) + 0.5
x = margin_scalar - diff
hinge_loss = relu(x)
weighted_loss = hinge_loss * weight
return sum(weighted_loss) / max(sum(weight), epsilon)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    epsilon = 1e-6
    norm_per_sample = ops.norm(advantage_gap)
    norm = ops.maximum(ops.mean(norm_per_sample), epsilon)
    diff = ops.div(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), norm)
    margin_scalar = ops.clamp(ops.mean(advantage_gap), 0.0, 1.0)
    margin_scalar = ops.add(margin_scalar, 0.5)  # margin offset to enforce minimum margin
    x = ops.sub(margin_scalar, diff)  # hinge argument = margin - difference
    hinge_loss = ops.relu(x)  # max(0, margin - diff)
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(hinge_loss, weight)
    loss = ops.div(ops.sum(weighted_loss), ops.maximum(ops.sum(weight), epsilon))
    return loss
